ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

appearance.note: Boxed renders each item as a bordered card; lined renders a flat list with dividers; plain has no borders.

behavior.note: Lock single mode so the open section cannot be collapsed, or set the heading level of every section header.

accordion.description: Vertically stacked expandable sections with single or multiple expand modes.

examples.note: Start with the default single-expand accordion, then explore modes and appearances below.

accordion.faq-answer-body: This is a simulated answer. Connect your AI backend to resolve real questions.
accordion.faq-q1-content: A design system for institutional products.
accordion.heading-level-note: The heading level input controls the header tag used for each section.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

accordion.item-account-content: Manage your personal information and profile preferences.
accordion.item-notifications-content: Choose which alerts and reminders you receive by email.
accordion.item-security-content: Review sign-in devices, active sessions, and recovery options.

leading-icon.note: Per-item icon glued to the label, rendered before the expand chevron.

accordion.lined-note: A flat list with a divider under each trigger instead of bordered cards.
accordion.locked-note: With allowToggle disabled, the open section cannot be collapsed.

modes.note: Single keeps one section open at a time; multiple toggles each section independently.

accordion.multi-a-content: View invoices and update your default payment method.
accordion.multi-b-content: Invite members and manage roles for your organization.
accordion.multiple-note: Sections toggle independently when the type is multiple.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

question.note: The last row is a question field. Submitting freezes the question as its label and shows a loading status; the host below simulates an AI backend with a delayed answer. Plug any backend into (submitted) and project the answer.

accordion.single-note: Only one section stays open at a time. Opening a section closes the previous one.

size-density.note: Size and density are owned by the container and propagate to every item, so all sections share the same geometry.

accordion.title: Accordion
